Definition: to be clear (in tone, i.e. shrill), i.e. to whoop
BiblicalUsage: tsârach is the ordinary word for to cry aloud, to shout. It appears 2 times in Scripture, including Isaiah 42:13 and Zephaniah 1:14.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that tsârach is one of the small details that matter in Scripture.
